notes: All 31 source morphemes and all 54 target tokens are partitioned exactly once; one `added` unit.
*unto Gath* is placed on the fronted bare accusative `גַּת` under rule 33; no preposition or marker stands on it.

*thither* in the closing clause is `added`: that clause writes no directional morpheme for the word to restate, so rule 44's clause-level reading does not keep it with the verb. The *about* of the preceding clause is by contrast part of the rendering of `סָבַב`, and the italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7). The competing reading — folding *thither* into `יַּסֵּבּוּ` as a phrasal particle — is set aside because the word states a destination rather than the verb's own 'around'.
The jussive `יִסֹּב` takes its whole volitive frame *Let ... be carried about* under rule 17, discontinuous around the subject, headed on the lexical verb.
The opening waw takes the postposed *therefore*; position does not break the unit (rules 14, 25).
